description: Forced page breaks: page-break-before/after and break-before/after: page all start a new page; avoid/auto do not, and a trailing break-after leaves no blank page.
visual_assertions: Five pages: Intro/Alpha, Legacy/Bravo, Modern/Charlie, After/Delta, then Last/Echo followed by Foxtrot.
Foxtrot sits directly under Echo on the final page — break-before: avoid forces nothing.
There is no blank sixth page from the trailing break-after.
